thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT streaming.p99 > 2.2s (2.35s) in us-west1 for streaming endpoints (auto-detect). Paging eng-oncall.
Olivia Chen: taking this — seeing multiple user-facing p99 spikes across long-context models. Starting triage.
Nate Park: confirming — p95 roughly stable, p99 and tail blips. Streaming stalls show long stalls (>2s) at decode tail.
Samir Joshi: fwiw we just had a kernel/toolchain push last night: trt8 runtime + kernel 5.15.2 packages to a subset of nodes. PR: infra/rollout/2026-03-14.
Jess Carter: also merged compile flag change for decode optimizer yesterday (PR #784-quant-flags). Could be related.
Maya (sre-lead): ok collect quick diffs: kernel versions, runtime builds, compiler flags. If rollback is fast, prefer rolling back kernel on a canary subset first. Runbook: "kernel-paging-live-mitigation".
Olivia Chen: reproducing on staging now with seq_length=4096 repro. hitting pagefault churn and KV cache eviction in logs. paste: ```[2026-03-15T02:12:09Z] WARN gpu-mem: pagefault handling exceeded threshold, evicting KV cache (keyspace=512MB)\n[2026-03-15T02:12:09Z] ERROR decode: tail stall 2439ms stacktrace...```
Nate Park: logs from prod pod gpu-prod-03 show lots of "compilepath: linking fallback path due to missing kernel symbol" entries. That smells like an ABI/driver mismatch causing slower fallback path that triggers streaming stalls.
Samir Joshi: here's the rollout diff: nodes A/B upgraded to linux-image-5.15.2 and runtime-trt8 build 2026-03-14. Canary group was 30% traffic.
Olivia Chen: plan: 1) route 30% of streaming traffic to dedi-legacy (older kernel pool) immediately, 2) rollback kernel on remaining impacted nodes if canary shows improvement, 3) revert compile flag if needed. sound ok?
deploy-bot: routing command accepted: /ops/reroute --from=pool=standard --to=pool=dedi-legacy --weight=30 --reason="paging live mitigation". Job id: 98321.
deploy-bot: reroute completed, 30% of new streaming sessions now land on dedi-legacy.
Samir Joshi: early canary metrics: p99 for canary dropped from 2.3s -> 0.95s within 90s after reroute. main pool still elevated.
Jess Carter: starting revert of PR #784 on runtime in parallel to be safe. I'll hold canary for a bit and watch.
Olivia Chen: Nate - can you run the kernel-rollback playbook on gpu-prod-03 (one of the hot nodes) once infra agrees? paste command we use: ```ansible-playbook playbooks/rollback-kernel.yml -e target=gpu-prod-03 -e kernel_version=5.14.8```
Nate Park: running now. infra-bot: please coordinate reboot window for gpu-prod-03.
infra-bot: rollback job queued. checking node health and running preflight. Job id: 789234. ETA ~3m to reboot.
Dina (support-ops): creating customer-facing note — "We’re investigating intermittent tail latency for streaming; mitigation in progress (routing & rollback). We'll update within 30m." Tagging top-10 customers for affected endpoints.
Maya (sre-lead): set incident priority P1 for now due to visible customer impact and SLO breach. Keep updates every 15m.
Olivia Chen: update after rollback on gpu-prod-03: node back up, runtime PID metrics look normal. p99 for that node: 0.88s.
Samir Joshi: good signal. rolling through 6/8 nodes in the affected group.
Jess Carter: revert of compile flag completed and runtime canary restarted. ```kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime -l canary=false```
Nate Park: rollout tasks progressing. infra-bot: update on job 789234 — rollback completed on nodes gpu-prod-03..gpu-prod-08 except gpu-prod-06 which failed preflight (disk pressure), skipping for now.
infra-bot: job 789234 status: 7/8 nodes rolled back. Remaining node scheduled for later maintenance window.
Samir Joshi: cluster-wide p99 aggregated dropped to 0.92s following rollbacks + reroute. Streaming stalls reduced, tail stalls are rare now.
Olivia Chen: status check: mitigation (reroute + kernel rollback + compile-flag revert) brought SLOs back within target. Continue monitoring for 30m.
Dina (support-ops): sending update to customers: "Mitigation applied — we routed traffic and rolled back a recent kernel upgrade. Performance restored for affected workloads; we will provide a timeline and POC in the upcoming postmortem"
Maya (sre-lead): great. please capture timeline and evidence for postmortem. Who owns write-up? Olivia? Samir?
Olivia Chen: I'll own incident write-up. Filing INFRA-1223 for follow-up: add regression test for compilepath paging + long context (seq >= 2048) and a canary gate on kernel/runtime upgrades.
Samir Joshi: also adding task: include kernel ABI compatibility checks in our rollout tooling, and add automated latency smoke for decode tail.
Jess Carter: note for runtime team: avoid landing quant/compiler flags that change code-gen paths without an integration test that includes long-context streaming.
Nate Park: final checks: monitoring is green, alert thresholds rearmed (incident-bot will quiet after 30m of stable).
incident-bot: Incident resolved (auto) — streaming.p99 back under threshold for 15m. Resolution timestamp: 7102345702.
Olivia Chen: closing thread — postmortem will include timeline, root cause: kernel ABI/driver change combined with new compile flags exposing a slow fallback in the compilepath causing pagefault churn and KV cache eviction -> decode tail stalls. Action items assigned in INFRA-1223. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
Maya (sre-lead): moving to postmortem channel and assigning follow-ups. Good work.
Dina (support-ops): will follow up with customer close-out note once postmortem is ready.
